Our History Since 1955, CBX Solutions has grown from a foundation in doors, frames, and hardware into a national network of specialists. Today, we bring together physical openings, security systems, and network technologies so everything works as one —through a single accountable partner. 1955 Cook & Boardman is founded, focused on providing quality doors, frames, and hardware to commercial construction projects. 1980s-2000s Expansion into new regional markets and the development of strong relationships with architects, contractors, and institutional owners. 2010s Strategic acquisitions broaden capabilities across specialty building systems, electronic security, and technology infrastructure. subpages.text: Shop Careers Locations Search Solutions Services Branches Resources Shop About Careers Contact Us Log in specialty solutions `` Specialty components that bring a plan together. Buildings are more than walls and openings—they’re systems people interact with every day. CBX Solutions provides specialty products that support performance, safety, and functionality, all coordinated with doors, hardware, security, and technology systems. When these elements are aligned, projects run smoother and buildings perform better long term. Why integration matters. Specialty products often intersect with multiple trades, codes, and performance requirements. When treated as separate scopes, coordination gaps can lead to delays, rework, and risk. CBX Solutions approaches specialty solutions as part of the broader building ecosystem. Our teams specify, source, and coordinate these elements alongside core opening systems—reducing complexity, minimizing surprises, and ensuring spaces function as intended from day one through long-term operation. Let’s build a better solution together. Whether you’re planning, building, or operating a complex facility, CBX Solutions is ready to help simplify coordination and protect performance.
